summary: Example task runs show version on Junos with junos_command.
questions: How do I get the Junos version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get Junos version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve Junos OS version
  junipernetworks.junos.junos_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'junipernetworks.junos.junos'
```
